ruleDefinitions.name: Automated Collection Command Prompt
ruleDefinitions.description: Once established within a system or network, an adversary may use automated techniques for collecting internal data.

sequences.query: (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.doc.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.docx.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.xls.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.xlsx.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.ppt.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.pptx.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.rtf.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.pdf.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.txt.*")) AND ((process_command_line = RGX(".*dir\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/b\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/s\\ .*")) OR (process_original_file_name = "FINDSTR\.EXE" AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/e\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/si\\ .*"))))
